choices.why: The 198 cm rectangular table in warm dark wood seats six to eight and matches the room's wood floor and stair rail.
Grey-taupe upholstered chairs with nailhead trim and dark legs give a classic but current look in grey fabric; three sets of two make six chairs.
The 66 cm five-arm chandelier in dark bronze is large enough for the table and its dark metal suits the wood and the classic style.
The 173 cm four-door sideboard in warm brown wood with cane fronts is a classic, warm piece that fits the length of the stair wall.

answer.why: The dark wood table, grey upholstered chairs, bronze chandelier and warm wood sideboard share a classic, warm palette that complements the cream walls and hardwood floors. The table and sideboard set the wood tones, while the chairs and lamp add grey and dark metal accents.
